crossRefs.note: For the time will come when they will not listen to the sound doctrine, but having itching ears, will heap up for…
and will turn away their ears from the truth, and turn away to fables.
But Yahweh has not given you a heart to know, eyes to see, and ears to hear, to this day.
A scoffer seeks wisdom, and doesn’t find it, but knowledge comes easily to a discerning person.
who tell the seers, “Don’t see!” and the prophets, “Don’t prophesy to us right things. Tell us pleasant things.…
Get out of the way. Turn away from the path. Cause the Holy One of Israel to cease from before us.”
Therefore speak to them, and tell them, ‘The Lord Yahweh says: “Every man of the house of Israel who takes his idols…
He answered them, “To you it is given to know the mysteries of the Kingdom of Heaven, but it is not given to them.
For everyone who does evil hates the light, and doesn’t come to the light, lest his works would be exposed.
But he who does the truth comes to the light, that his works may be revealed, that they have been done in God.”
How can you believe, who receive glory from one another, and you don’t seek the glory that comes from the only God?
Nevertheless even many of the rulers believed in him, but because of the Pharisees they didn’t confess it, so that they…
for they loved men’s praise more than God’s praise.
Brothers, I couldn’t speak to you as to spiritual, but as to fleshly, as to babies in Christ.
that we may no longer be children, tossed back and forth and carried about with every wind of doctrine, by the trickery…
About him we have many words to say, and hard to interpret, seeing you have become dull of hearing.
who desires all people to be saved and come to full knowledge of the truth.
in gentleness correcting those who oppose him: perhaps God may give them repentance leading to a full knowledge of the…
